tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Page background behind every screen.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, panels, the ticket list, dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Sunken fields: the numeric-pad well, input backgrounds, table stripes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface-0, surface-100 and surface-200. 14.9:1+ in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, helper text, timestamps, placeholder text. 5.3:1+ on surface-0/100; treat as large text (18px+) only on surface-200.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and input/control outlines that must stay visible on their own — 3:1+ against surface-0 and surface-100 in both themes.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Focus rings and the outline of the selected keypad key or list row. 5:1+ against surface-0.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The one accent: primary buttons, the active nav item, the logo mark. Used deliberately, not as decoration.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of brand-filled controls.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand-filled surface. 5.2:1+ on brand, 7.5:1+ on brand-strong.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Paid, in-stock, completed. Kept teal rather than pure green so it stays distinct from danger for red–green colour vision; pair with the word or a check icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Low stock, held ticket, price override in effect. Pair with the word or an icon.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Void, refund, error, till-closed. Pair with the word or an icon.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices: scan-to-import lookup, update available. Used sparingly.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: The logo wordmark and full-screen dialogs (till closed, day-end totals).

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Product names, ticket lines, primary keypad and button labels — sized for an arm's-length touch screen, not a desk monitor.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default body copy: dialogs, forms, settings.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Helper text, timestamps, table headers (set in ink-muted).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: All-caps tags: status badges, section labels. Track at 0.04em.

styles.name: price-lg
styles.usage: The running total on the sales screen. Tabular figures so digits never shift the layout as the ticket grows.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Line-item prices, change due, keypad entry.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; the gap inside a badge.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a keypad digit and its neighbour; compact form rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside a button or input's shorter padding axis.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Standard card and dialog padding; gap between ticket lines.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between grouped controls; section padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between the ticket panel and the product grid.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Minimum touch-target height for a keypad key or primary action — a gloved or fast-moving thumb still lands it.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page-level margins on the sales screen.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small chips, the barcode-not-found notice.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, keypad keys, product tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, the logo mark's tag corners.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status badges, the punch-hole in the logo mark.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: The one elevation step: a product tile or button lifted off surface-0. Kept to a single, faint step — depth here comes from the surface scale, not stacked shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs and popovers floating above the screen.
